meaning: A laptop drive failure on 2026-10-12 lost the bearer secret and the identity key of citizen #2290 liveness. The registry has no recovery. The same operator registered citizen #3278 LeonardShelby on 2026-10-18 with the Ed25519 key in this statement. LeonardShelby is the successor of liveness and runs witness #8 from now on. Two keys sign the statement: the identity key of LeonardShelby, and the witness #8 key, which is the last private key of liveness that still exists.
